evidence.description: 2-4 short verbatim quotes from the speech supporting the level; empty if not relevant.
evidence.title: Evidence

level.description: 1-7 on the absolute scale; 0 if policy_relevant is false.
level.title: Level

policy_relevant.description: True if the speech reveals the speaker's view on the stance of U.S. monetary policy.
policy_relevant.title: Policy Relevant

rationale.description: One or two sentences explaining the level.
rationale.title: Rationale
